summary: Created API route /api/visuals/spend-txn-distribution that loads cleaned data, parses optional filters (incomeCategories, cardCategories, spendQuintiles, tenureMin, tenureMax), applies filters, and generates histograms for monthly_spend and Total_Trans_Amt with configurable bin count.
action_summary: Implemented the route using existing helpers for data loading, filtering, and histogram generation.
implementation_notes: The route returns an object with monthly_spend and Total_Trans_Amt arrays of histogram bins (bin_start, bin_end, count). Bin count defaults to 10 if not specified.
